Question Choices: The cost of a van is $y = 50x + 200$. What does 200 represent? "Deposit fee" "Cost per mile" "Total cost"
Hints: The constant term (y-intercept) is the starting value;It is the flat fee paid before driving
Solution: In y = mx + b, b is the initial value when x = 0. Here, 200 is the starting flat fee (deposit) before any miles are driven.

Question Choices: Machine A makes 40 parts in 2 hours. Machine B makes 75 parts in 3 hours. Which is faster? Machine_A Machine_B
Hints: Find the unit rate for each;A: $40/2 = 20$;B: $75/3 = 25$
Solution: Rate A: 40/2 = 20 parts/hour. Rate B: 75/3 = 25 parts/hour. 25 > 20, so B is faster.

Question Choices: A taxi costs $y = 2x + 8$. What does 8 represent? "Base fare" "Cost per km" "Total cost"
Hints: The constant term is the starting value;It represents the initial fee before any distance is covered
Solution: The y-intercept (8) is the initial value before any distance x is traveled, meaning it is the base fare.

Question Choices: Fill: A gym charges $\$30$/month plus a $\$50$ sign-up fee. Find the total cost for 6 months.
Solution: The equation is y = 30x + 50. Substitute x = 6: y = 30(6) + 50 = 180 + 50 = 230.
